row.name: A10 Networks Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=2 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.28 tightness=0.95 base_volume_vs_leg=0.78 base_volume_vs_avg=0.75
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 2 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 9.6% vs its 20-SMA, 19.8% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The signal bar itself is clean — closes at 99% of its range, above the open, with a 5.97% gain — but the base is only 2 sessions, which is outside Bonde's 3–20 window and recorded as a PARTIAL on C, and the tightness proxy of 0.95 is near the ceiling of the A+ threshold, meaning the two-bar consolidation is barely a consolidation at all. Volume on the burst is only 78% of the 50-session average and ranks 40th of the last 60 sessions, which is ordinary rather than compelling. The prior leg's R² of 0.49 is below the A+ dual threshold, and the note that prior breakouts worked only 1 of 4 times in the last 60 sessions adds a meaningful caution.
claude.key_risk: A two-session base provides almost no consolidation evidence, and below-average burst volume means institutional conviction is not confirmed.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst bar's close of 29.63 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest above the prior day's high.
